{"rules": ["Model consistently underestimates the magnitude of price spikes during strong bullish sentiment (sentiment > 0.20), failing to capture volatility expansion.", "Forecast shows excessive smoothing and lag; true outcomes exhibit high-frequency oscillations that the model misses entirely.", "When recent history shows a sharp upward trend, the model predicts a linear continuation while actual prices reverse or consolidate within 5-10 days.", "Model fails to account for mean reversion after rapid rallies, predicting higher peaks than reality when sentiment remains neutral or slightly positive.", "Forecast horizon bias: Model assumes stability in the second half of the 30-day window, whereas true outcomes show increased volatility and range expansion."]
